_comments: Approval of an exception to payment-gated access (bizapps-orders#268). Its own type, rather
than the generic Approval Request, so that closing the task in the Tasks inbox runs the Action that
applies the decision to the override.

fields.Name: Access Override Approval
fields.Description: Approve or reject an exception to payment-gated access on an order. Closing the task applies the decision to the override.

_comments: Approval of a Pending concession (golive #274, #312). Its own type, rather than the generic Approval
Request, so that its OnAssign action posts concession approvals, and only those, to the Teams channel
named by the 'Teams Channel Webhook' credential called ORDERS_CONCESSION_APPROVAL. IsApproval lists its
tasks in the Tasks approvals inbox.

fields.Name: Concession Approval
fields.Description: Approve or reject a Pending concession on an order. The order cannot be confirmed, and its documents cannot be sent, until the concession is decided.
